contexts: Separate pages and sessionStorage identities; shared browser context to fit Windows commit budget. Cookies/localStorage shared; application identity does not use them.
method: Start: actual host command dispatch in app. Delivery: recipient Socket.IO state handler. Applied: first non-seeking video sample matching paused state and within 500ms of authoritative timeline, with a state version at least as new as the command. Browser clocks calibrated to a single Node monotonic clock using minimum RTT of 7 Playwright evaluations per page. Application sampled on command, playing/seeked/canplay events and each 100ms correction tick. Drift measured from HTML5 currentTime one second after each control; offset from app ping estimator.
limitations: Localhost only, shared machine. Autoplay allowed by test flag and audio muted. Background throttling disabled. Player application criterion is state/timeline, not frame presentation timestamp. Clock calibration uncertainty approximately half calibration RTT. Windows load average does not reflect CPU load.
